default.description: AUTO-GENERATED by cargo run --bin generate_contracts from src/command_contract.rs; grants the main window the generated Waves host command contract.

developer-tools-host.description: Allows the main Waves window to open and focus the least-privileged Developer Tools window and exchange frontend events with it.

developer-tools-window.description: Allows the detached Waves Developer Tools window to exchange frontend-only state and action events with the main window.
